title: 现在完成时 vs 过去完成时

questions.stem: — Do you know this city well? — Yes, I ____ (live) here for ten years.

options.distractor: 没有过去参照点，参照点是“现在”
for ten years 表示持续到现在

questions.explanation: “住到现在十年了”，参照点是现在，用 have lived。

questions.stem: He ____ (work) in that factory for five years before he moved here.

options.distractor: moved here 是过去参照点
“到搬来之前为止”要用过去完成时

questions.explanation: before he moved here 是过去参照点，用 had worked。

questions.stem: — You look happy. — Yes, I ____ (get) a gift from my friend.

options.distractor: 这里没有过去参照点，说的是现在的状态
强调对现在的影响（所以开心）

questions.explanation: 解释“现在看起来高兴”，参照点是现在，用 have got。

questions.stem: The old man ____ (be) dead for two years when we heard the news.

options.distractor: “到听到消息时为止已去世两年”要用过去完成时

questions.explanation: 听到消息（过去参照点）时已去世两年，用 had been dead。

options.text: I have never seen such a big apple.
She had left before I arrived.
He has finished the work when the boss came back.
We have known each other since 2018.

questions.explanation: came back 是过去参照点，应改为 He had finished the work when the boss came back。

questions.stem: — Why was Tom so sad yesterday? — Because he ____ (lose) his new bike the day before.

options.distractor: “前天丢车、昨天难过”，参照点在过去
丢车在难过之前，是更早的动作

questions.explanation: 解释昨天为什么难过：前天（更早）丢了车，用 had lost。
